input.quote: 15.4 Except as otherwise expressly set forth in this Agreement, neither Party makes any representation or extends any warranties of any kind either express or implied, including, but not limited to, warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, noninfringement or validity of any patents issued or pending
input.rationale: Article 15 contains only Effective-Date representations (IP title, no litigation, past regulatory compliance) and forward covenants (no debarment, anti-bribery); Array gives no warranty that its performance under the Agreement will meet professional/industry standards on an ongoing basis and no warranty that the Materials it supplies under Article 9 will conform to specifications or GMP, and there is no repair/replace/refund remedy anywhere. Section 15.4 then disclaims all implied warranties, including merchantability and fitness for a particular purpose, so Ono is left effectively taking supplied Materials "as is" — walk-away territory under the rule and well short of even the fallback (90-day conformance warranty with remedy). Article 9 defers specifications to future supply and quality agreements, which is not a present warranty. Redline inserts a new Section 15.4 performance/conformance warranty with a 90-day notice window and a re-perform, replace or refund remedy (plus no-malicious-code and compliance-with-law elements) and renumbers the disclaimer; no carve-out is needed because the disclaimer already opens with "Except as otherwise expressly set forth in this Agreement".

ops.text: 15.4 Performance and Product Warranty. Array warrants that (a) all Development, Manufacturing, supply and other activities performed by or on behalf of Array under this Agreement will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards and in compliance with applicable Law (including, where applicable, Good Manufacturing Practices); (b) each shipment of Materials supplied by Array to Ono under Article 9 will, at the time of delivery, conform in all material respects to the applicable specifications and will have been Manufactured in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices and applicable Law, and will not be adulterated or misbranded; and (c) the Materials and any software or electronic deliverables provided by Array hereunder will not contain any virus or other malicious code. For any non-conformance with the foregoing warranties of which Ono notifies Array within ninety (90) days following delivery (or, in the case of a latent defect, within ninety (90) days after Ono's discovery thereof), Array shall, at Array's option, re-perform the affected activities, replace the non-conforming Materials or deliverable, or refund the amounts paid or payable by Ono for the same, in each case without limiting any other remedy available to Ono under this Agreement.

ops.oldText: 15.4 Except as otherwise expressly set forth in this Agreement
ops.newText: 15.5 Except as otherwise expressly set forth in this Agreement

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added an express performance and product conformance warranty for Array's activities and supplied Materials, with a 90-day notice period and a re-perform/replace/refund remedy, as our playbook requires the supplier to stand behind its work with a real remedy. As drafted the Agreement contains only Effective-Date representations and then disclaims all implied warranties, leaving Ono with no conformance remedy for Materials; the existing disclaimer already preserves express warranties, so only renumbering is needed.
proposal.summary: Insert express performance/conformance warranty for Array with 90-day notice and re-perform, replace or refund remedy; renumber the disclaimer.
